plain.li: Saw {X_indefinite} up close today. I don't have a word for it, and I've tried a few.
Drew {X_definite} in the margin of this page. It doesn't look like that. Nothing looks like that.
[skill:Animals] Watched {X_definite} for an hour. I'd give a lot to know whether it could be tamed.
[child] I saw {X_indefinite}! The grown-ups think I'm making it up, but it's true.
[old] All these years, and the world still has things in it I've never seen. Today it was {X_indefinite}.

warm.li: Saw {X_indefinite} today. I kept turning to point it out to someone, and there was no one there.

blunt.li: Strange animal by the colony today. Left it alone. It left me alone.

cheerful.li: Saw the strangest creature today! I'll be telling people about it for a week.

gloomy.li: This planet keeps making things like {X_indefinite}. I didn't ask for any of them.

cold.li: Noted {X_indefinite} near the colony: its size, its habits, which way it went.
